text: THOSE DESCRIPTIONS OF SKIN-COLORED, NONTENDER, PEARLY PAPULES WITH CENTRAL UMBILICATION ARE HIGHLY SPECIFIC. speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal blood work is reassuring; however, the description of skin-colored, pearly papules with central umbilication is classic for Molluscum Contagiosum. Since we have asked two questions and need to gather a total of ten, I will continue by asking: How many of these lesions do you have, and have they appeared anywhere on your face or genitals?

REQUEST TEST: None needed at this time; we will rely on physical history for now.
REQUEST IMAGES: Do you have any close-up photos of the lesions showing the central dimple?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum
